text: The future of artificial intelligence is a topic that interests many people. Today we have "narrow AI," which is good at one specific task, like translating languages. However, researchers are working on "general AI" (AGI), a system that could think and learn like a human across many different areas. AGI could bring great benefits, such as solving medical problems or helping with climate change. On the other hand, it also carries serious risks, including job losses and safety concerns. Experts disagree about the timeline. Some predict AGI within ten years, while others believe it is still far away. Either way, society needs to prepare carefully.
